overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（9 篇）、绿色金融与可持续发展（1 篇）、公司金融（1 篇）。方法上以模型校准、随机过程为主。来源分布：arXiv（8 篇）、Semantic Scholar（4 篇）。其中 3 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: When Does Storage Complement Solar? Investment and Cost Recovery under Advanced Net Metering
papers.abstract: We examine the joint PV and storage operational and investment decisions of a prosumer under net energy metering (NEM) and peak/off-peak tariffs. Legacy NEM compensates net exports at the retail rate over a netting period, typically under time-invariant pricing. To better reflect system costs, tariff features are being reconsidered, with many U.S. states adopting time-varying prices and export compensation below the retail price. We formulate the prosumer decision problem as a cost minimization problem with charge/discharge, PV investment, and storage investment decisions. We analytically derive the optimal decisions based on the tariff's membership in one of six regions that partition the tariff space. Using these solutions, we examine the relationship between PV and storage, identifying when they are complements or substitutes. Furthermore, we identify the relationship between private DER incentives and the distribution utility's (DU's) net cost of serving the prosumer. For both storage and PV, when investment costs are greater than the costs of serving the customer, there is no tariff where investment in PV and storage decrease non-adopter bills. Under the same conditions, complementarity between PV and storage decreases DU cost recovery for a given tariff. In a Massachusetts-based case study, we validate our theoretical findings by connecting tariff design features to DER interaction, the DU's net cost, and DER adoption in a stochastic, multi-prosumer, and multi-period setting.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在净能量计量（NEM）制度及分时电价机制下，具有发电和用电双重功能的用户（prosumer）在光伏发电（PV）与储能系统运营及投资决策方面的协同行为。传统的NEM制度会在一个结算周期内，按照零售电价对用户的净发电量进行补偿，且该定价通常保持不变。为更准确地反映系统的实际成本，许多美国州正在重新设计电价结构，采用分时定价机制，并对超出零售电量的发电量提供低于零售电价的补偿。我们将用户的决策问题构建为一个成本最小化模型，其中包含充电/放电行为、光伏投资以及储能投资决策。我们通过分析得出了在六个不同电价区间内用户的最优决策方案。基于这些分析结果，我们探讨了光伏发电与储能系统之间的互补或替代关系，并分析了私人分布式能源资源（DER）激励措施与配电公司（DU）为这类用户提供服务所产生的净成本之间的关联。对于储能和光伏发电项目而言，当其投资成本高于为用户提供服务的成本时，不存在任何能够同时降低非用户用电量所产生的电费的单一定价方案。在相同条件下，光伏发电与储能之间的互补性会降低配电公司在特定电价下的成本回收率。通过以马萨诸塞州为例的案例研究，我们将电价设计特点与分布式能源资源的互动...。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: Finding Competitive Equilibria in Online Marketplaces with Platform Fees, Taxes, and Subsidies
papers.abstract: We study equilibrium computation in multi-unit trading networks with valuations satisfying generalized full substitutes and agent- and transaction-specific piecewise-linear transfer functions. These transfers model platform fees, taxes, subsidies, and membership discounts in online marketplaces. Our ascending procedure raises prices at different rates and reaches the minimum equilibrium price vector in finitely many iterations, each implementable in strongly polynomial time under our oracle and arithmetic models. An equilibrium allocation can then be recovered efficiently. The method extends primal-dual techniques developed for ascending auctions to handle complementarities between purchases and sales through a submodular flow formulation. In single-seller markets with substitutes and complements, our framework also extends the double-track auctions of Sun and Yang (2009) and Shioura and Yang (2015) to bidder- and good-specific transfers.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在多单元交易网络中的均衡计算问题，这些网络的估值满足广义完全替代品假设，并且交易双方及交易本身具有分段线性转移函数。这些转移函数用于模拟在线市场中的平台费用、税收、补贴以及会员折扣等机制。我们提出的渐进式定价算法以不同的速率逐步提高价格，并在有限次迭代后达到最小均衡价格向量；每次迭代均可在我们的预言机模型和算术模型下以强多项式时间复杂度完成。随后可以高效地恢复均衡分配结果。该方法通过引入次模流（submodular flow）公式，将原本为升价拍卖设计的原始-对偶（primal-dual）技术扩展到了处理购买与销售之间互补性问题的场景。在存在替代品和互补品的单一卖方市场中，我们的框架还进一步扩展了Sun和Yang（2009年）以及Shioura和Yang（2015年）提出的双轨拍卖机制，使其能够适应针对不同投标者和商品类型的转移函数。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Towards a Low‐Carbon Economy: How Carbon Pricing Mitigates the Adverse Environmental Impact of Financial Development
papers.abstract:
This study examines whether carbon pricing can reconcile financial development with environmental sustainability using a panel of 70 developed and developing countries over the period 1990–2024. Employing an interaction framework and alternative measures of carbon‐pricing adoption and price stringency, we find that financial development increases CO
 2
 emissions, whereas carbon pricing directly reduces emissions and weakens the adverse environmental effects of financial expansion. Emissions trading systems exhibit more consistent and precisely estimated mitigation effects than carbon taxes. Importantly, the effectiveness of carbon taxation depends on the strength of the price signal: while the adoption of a carbon tax alone is not significantly associated with emissions, higher carbon‐tax rates are associated with significant emissions reductions. This finding suggests that introducing a carbon tax may be insufficient unless rates are stringent enough to alter production, investment and energy‐use decisions. Mechanism analysis further indicates that carbon pricing supports decarbonisation by encouraging a shift from fossil fuels towards renewable energy. Its effectiveness has strengthened since the Paris Agreement, particularly for emissions trading systems. The findings are robust to alternative specifications and tests addressing endogeneity. Overall, the results demonstrate that carbon pricing can mitigate the environmental costs of financial development and facilitate the transition towards cleaner energy. They also highlight the importance of aligning the choice and design of carbon‐pricing instruments with countries' economic conditions, institutional capacities and climate‐policy objectives.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】本研究通过分析1990至2024年间70个发达国家和发展中国家的数据，探讨了碳定价是否能够在金融发展与环境可持续性之间实现平衡。通过运用交互作用模型以及多种碳定价采纳方式和价格严格程度的衡量指标，研究发现：金融发展会加剧二氧化碳排放，而碳定价则能够直接减少排放，并缓解金融扩张对环境的负面影响。相比之下，碳排放交易体系在减排效果上更为显著且估计更为精确。值得注意的是，碳税的有效性取决于价格信号的强度：单纯采用碳税并不能显著降低排放量，只有较高的碳税税率才能带来显著的减排效果。这一结果表明，除非碳税税率足够高，足以影响生产、投资和能源使用决策，否则仅实施碳税可能难以达到预期效果。机制分析进一步表明，碳定价通过促进从化石燃料向可再生能源的转型来支持脱碳进程。自《巴黎协定》签署以来，碳定价的有效性得到了进一步提升，尤其是碳排放交易体系。研究结果对不同的模型设定和内生性检验都具有较强的稳健性。总体而言，研究表明碳定价有助于减轻金融发展带来的环境成本，并推动向清洁能源的转型。同时，这也强调了在制定碳定价政策时，需要充分考虑各国的经济状况、制度能力及气候政策目标。。

papers.title: Increase Fund Source and Reduce Expenditures: Supplier Stability and Firms' Short‐Term Debt for Long‐Term Investment
papers.abstract: The maturity mismatch arising from short‐term debt for long‐term investment is an important source of financial risk. In this paper, we examine whether supplier stability influences a firm's reliance on short‐term debt for long‐term investment. We find that stable supplier relationships significantly mitigate such maturity mismatches. The effect is stronger in non‐state‐owned enterprises, firms with higher financing constraints, and firms operating in poorer information environments. Mechanism tests suggest that there are two channels through which supplier stability operates: it broadens firms' funding sources and reduces expenditures. Additionally, we find that the supplier stability‐driven improvements in financing structure reduce firms' financial risks and increase market value. Overall, our findings highlight the role of supplier stability in optimizing firms' financing policies and extend the maturity matching literature by incorporating a supply chain perspective.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】由于短期债务用于长期投资而产生的期限错配是金融风险的重要来源。在本文中，我们研究了供应商稳定性是否会影响企业依赖短期债务进行长期投资的程度。研究发现，稳定的供应商关系能够显著缓解这种期限错配现象。这种效应在非国有企业、融资约束较大的企业以及信息环境较差的企业中更为明显。机制分析表明，供应商稳定性通过两种途径发挥作用：一是拓宽企业的资金来源，二是降低企业的支出成本。此外，我们还发现，供应商稳定性带来的融资结构改善能够降低企业的财务风险并提升其市场价值。总体而言，我们的研究结果强调了供应商稳定性在优化企业融资政策中的作用，并通过引入供应链视角拓展了关于期限匹配问题的学术研究。。

papers.title: Optimal Policy With Noisy Sufficient Statistics
papers.abstract: We study how policy-makers should set $k$ policy instruments so as to best hit $m$ (perhaps dynamic) targets, in a linear-quadratic model where there is statistical uncertainty about the causal effects of the policies. Plugging the estimated effects into "sufficient statistics" optimal policy formulas, as commonly done in the literature, can result in infinite risk. In fact, maintaining the status quo regardless of the data is uniquely minimax-optimal when $m>1$, and uniquely minimax-regret-optimal when $m,k>1$. Nevertheless, we recommend that policy-makers adopt a simple, dampened version of the popular plug-in rule, as in Fisher (1962) and Brainard (1967). Not only does this cautious rule outperform doing nothing over most of the parameter space, its worst-case risk is also close to the minimax value in empirically relevant models. Policy-makers should use causal effect estimates from an unbiased but dispersed estimator (such as a local projection) rather than from a moderately biased but precise estimator (such as a vector autoregression).
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了政策制定者应如何设定$k$个政策工具，以便在存在政策因果效应统计不确定性的线性-二次模型中最佳地实现$m$个（可能是动态的）目标。将估计的效应代入文献中常用的“充分统计量”最优政策公式中，可能会导致无限风险。实际上，当$m>1$时，无论数据如何，维持现状都是唯一的极小极大最优选择；而当$m,k>1$时，维持现状则是唯一的极小极大遗憾最优选择。尽管如此，我们仍建议政策制定者采用Fisher（1962）和Brainard（1967）提出的简单、缓和版的插入规则。这种谨慎的规则不仅在大多数参数空间内优于不采取任何行动的策略，其最坏情况风险也接近于实证相关模型中的极小极大值。政策制定者应使用无偏但估计分散的估计方法（如局部投影）来获取因果效应估计值，而不是使用有偏但估计精确的方法（如向量自回归）。。研究方法：向量自回归、局部投影法、回归分析。

papers.title: Exponential Convergence of the Lifted Gradient Flow of the Bass Functional
papers.abstract: We establish multidimensional exponential convergence of the lifted Bass gradient flow in martingale optimal transport. Let $μ\le_{cx}ν$ be an irreducible pair, with compact convex target support, source support strictly inside the target support, and target density bounded above and bounded away from zero almost everywhere on its interior. For every bounded $σ(X)$-measurable initial state, the flow converges exponentially in $L^2$ to the global minimizer with the prescribed mean, and the functional value gap decays exponentially. Both bounds hold at every nonnegative time with the exact initial errors as prefactors. The quantitative step is strong convexity on sets with a common $L^\infty$ bound and a fixed mean. We prove it by interpolating entropic endpoint potentials, using two conditional copies to cancel the unknown potential increment, and obtaining a Hessian lower bound uniform in the regularization parameter. Removing the regularization yields curvature for the original functional; the known qualitative theory supplies a common bound for the orbit. This extends the one-dimensional exponential-convergence result of Backhoff-Veraguas, Pammer, and Schachermayer. The main result is formalized in Lean 4. AI was used in preparing the paper (see Section 8).
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们证明了在鞅最优传输框架下，提升后的Bass梯度流具有多维指数收敛性。设$(\mu, \nu)$是一对不可约随机变量，其目标支撑集为紧致凸集，源支撑集严格位于目标支撑集内部，并且目标密度的值在其内部几乎处处都有上界且不为零。对于任意有界的$\sigma(X)$-可测初始状态，该流在$L^2$范数下会指数级收敛到全局最小化器，并且函数值差距也会指数级减小。这两个收敛性质在任意非负时间点都成立，且初始误差以精确的系数形式作为前因子。定量分析依赖于具有共同$L^\infty$界限和固定均值的集合上的强凸性。我们的证明方法包括：通过插值熵端点势函数，利用两个条件副本来消除未知的势增量，并得到一个与正则化参数无关的Hessian下界。去除正则化处理后，原始函数会呈现出曲率特性；已知的定性理论为流形的轨道提供了统一的界限。这一结果扩展了Backhoff-Veraguas、Pammer和Schachermayer在一维情况下得到的指数收敛性结论。主要结果已在Lean 4中进行了形式化表述。本文的撰写过程中使用了人工智能技术（详见第8节）。。

papers.title: Comparing tail forecasts: the number of exceedances is the sample size
papers.abstract: When two forecasts of a tail, such as prediction intervals at high coverage, extreme quantiles or expected shortfall (ES), are compared by a consistent score, the score difference is known in advance except on the days on which the outcome falls beyond a forecast. The number of these exceedances, not the number of observations, is the effective sample size. For intervals at miscoverage level $α$, the number of observations a comparison needs grows like $1/α$ while the number of exceedances it needs does not, and for some pairs of forecasts no test can do better. A confidence sequence that is valid at all times and needs no distributional assumption attains this rate; Hoeffding-type procedures, calibrated by the range of the score difference, need $1/α$ times more. When exceedances are scarce, the Diebold-Mariano test declares the less conservative forecaster better with at least, asymptotically, the probability of observing no exceedance, whichever forecaster is actually better; the usual small-sample corrections do not remove this, while a bootstrap-t version largely does. For (value-at-risk, ES) forecasts, a less conservative ES can be shown without assumptions to be worse on the days on which it is less conservative, but never to be better without an assumption on the loss tail. In 250-day windows of 97.5% forecasts for seven stock indices, 18.4% of significant Diebold-Mariano results favouring the less conservative model contradict the ranking on the remaining days, against 6.9% of those favouring the more conservative one.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】当通过一个一致的评分标准来比较两种关于尾部特征的预测（例如高覆盖率下的预测区间、极端分位数或预期亏损（ES））时，评分差异是可以提前预测的——除非实际结果超出了某项预测的范畴。真正影响评估结果的是“超出预测的次数”，而非观测值的总数；这一超出次数实际上构成了有效的样本量。对于覆盖率水平为α的预测区间，进行比较所需的观测值数量会以1/α的速度增长，而所需的超出次数则不会相应增加；对于某些预测对而言，任何检验方法都无法达到更好的评估效果。一种在任何情况下都有效且无需任何分布假设的置信序列能够实现这种评估效率；而通过评分差异范围进行校准的Hoeffding型检验方法则需要1/α倍的观测值数量。当超出预测的情况较为罕见时，Diebold-Mariano检验会判定较为保守的预测模型更优（至少在渐近意义上，无论实际哪个模型更优，这种判定都能保证“没有观测到超出预测的情况”）；通常的小样本修正方法无法消除这种偏差，而自助法（bootstrap）版本则能在很大程度上纠正这一问题。对于风险价值（Value-at-Risk, ES）预测而言，即使在没有假设的情况下，也可以证明较为保守的ES预测模型在...。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: Crowds Believe in You: Online Prediction Markets Overestimate How Often People Achieve Their Own Goals
papers.abstract: People increasingly share personal goals online and invite others to forecast them. Research on the planning fallacy finds that observers predict a person's behavior less optimistically than the person does, and prediction markets aggregate such judgments, harnessing the wisdom of crowds. We study 6,150 prediction markets on Manifold in which 1,660 users asked about their own futures ("Will I ...?"), reconstruct every order and execution, and compare these self-markets with markets about external events. Self-markets resolved YES 4.4 percentage points less often than their final prices implied, whereas external markets were nearly calibrated (0.9 points); the difference was 2.2 points at the same price level and 1.9 points within creators who made both kinds of market. Absent when markets opened, the overstatement emerged within a day of trading, even where the person never traded, and peaked in the week before close. In a market's first day, observers moved external-market prices down toward the base rate, but moved self-market prices 3.6 points further toward YES, except in markets naming an outcome the person would not want, which were not overpriced. The correction came late and largely from the person, whose orders supplied 38% of the eventual movement toward the outcome in self-markets, against 9% in external markets. Because self-market prices mainly failed to separate successes from failures, a recalibration learned from earlier markets improved later forecasts by only 1.5%. Crowds believe in the futures people pose for themselves, and the information that would correct them lies with the person.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】人们越来越多地在网络上分享个人目标，并邀请他人对这些目标进行预测。关于“规划谬误”（planning fallacy）的研究发现，观察者对个人行为的预测往往比当事人本身更为悲观。预测市场通过汇集这些判断，利用了“群体智慧”（wisdom of crowds）。我们研究了Manifold平台上的6,150个预测市场，其中1,660名用户对自己的未来进行了预测（例如“我会……吗？”）。我们重新分析了所有交易订单和执行过程，并将这些关于个人未来的预测市场与那些针对外部事件的预测市场进行了比较。结果显示，针对个人未来的预测市场给出的“是”（YES）的预测结果比最终实际结果低4.4个百分点；而针对外部事件的预测市场则几乎与实际情况相符（仅低0.9个百分点）。在相同的价格水平下，这种差异为2.2个百分点；在同时参与两种类型预测市场的用户中，这一差异为1.9个百分点。这种过度乐观的预测在市场开盘时并不存在，但在交易一天内就开始显现，即使当事人并未进行任何交易；这种趋势在交易结束前一周达到顶峰。在市场运行的第一天，观察者会将外部市场的价格拉向基准水平，但会将针对个人未来的预测市场的价格进一步推向...。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: A Proof for Generalized Egalitarianism
papers.abstract: This paper proves a rigidity theorem characterizing the Gini-type Lorenz-area ordering under general decision-theoretic constraints together with weak Lorenz dominance, thereby resolving the characterization problem pursued in this line of research on egalitarianism. This does not, of course, bring the broader inquiry to an end. In a certain sense, it may instead mark a step beyond the infancy of our attempt to connect social choice theory, welfare economics, and formal moral philosophy through a common mathematical language. The main proof strategy was originally obtained by the author's own hand, though 5.6sol and Astra could effortlessly reproduce it without any additional hint.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文证明了一个刚性定理，该定理描述了在一般决策理论约束条件下以及弱洛伦兹优势（weak Lorenz dominance）作用下的基尼型洛伦兹面积排序（Gini-type Lorenz-area ordering）特征，从而解决了这一平等主义研究领域长期存在的特征描述问题。当然，这并不意味着更广泛的探索就此结束。从某种意义上说，这反而可能标志着我们试图通过共同的数学语言将社会选择理论、福利经济学和形式道德哲学联系起来的努力迈出了重要一步。主要的证明策略最初是由作者本人独立完成的，不过5.6sol和Astra无需任何额外提示便能够轻松复现这一证明过程。。

papers.title: THE SPATIAL COORDINATION MECHANISMS AND OPTIMIZATION PATHWAYS FOR URBAN ELDERLY CARE RESOURCES IN THE CONTEXT OF AN AGING POPULATION: AN ANALYSIS BASED ON GUANGZHOU
papers.venue: Journal of Trends in Finance and Economics
papers.abstract: To explore the issue of spatial coordination of elderly care service resources in megacities against the backdrop of population aging, this study takes Guangzhou as its case and analyzes the practical challenges, formation mechanisms, and optimization pathways for the allocation of elderly care service resources from the perspective of spatial governance. The study finds that population aging in Guangzhou exhibits distinct spatial differentiation, characterized by the coexistence of an aging population concentration in the central urban area and rapid aging in peripheral regions, with demand for elderly care gradually shifting from overall growth to regionally differentiated development. Currently, the allocation of elderly care resources still faces issues such as an incomplete alignment between resource distribution and population trends, insufficient coordination between regional supply and demand, and limited levels of coordinated resource utilization. The primary causes lie in a temporal mismatch between population dynamics and public resource planning, administrative boundaries that restrict the spatial mobility of elderly care resources, and a traditional supply-oriented model that fails to adequately respond to diverse elderly care needs. Consequently, it is necessary to improve demand identification mechanisms, optimize the spatial distribution of elderly care resources, strengthen cross-regional collaborative governance, and promote a shift from the decentralized allocation of elderly care resources to coordinated spatial allocation, thereby enhancing the adaptability and governance effectiveness of the elderly care service system in megacities.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】为探讨人口老龄化背景下大城市中老年护理服务资源的空间协调问题，本研究以广州为案例，从空间治理的角度分析了老年护理服务资源配置的实际挑战、形成机制及优化路径。研究发现，广州的人口老龄化现象存在明显的空间差异：中心城区老龄化人口较为集中，而周边地区老龄化进程迅速加快；对老年护理的需求正从整体增长转向区域差异化发展。目前，老年护理资源的配置仍存在资源分布与人口趋势不匹配、区域供需协调不足以及资源利用效率低下等问题。其主要原因包括人口动态与公共资源规划之间的时间错配、限制老年护理资源空间流动的行政边界，以及未能充分满足多样化老年护理需求的传统供给导向型模式。因此，有必要改进需求识别机制，优化老年护理资源的空间分布，加强跨区域协同治理，并推动老年护理资源配置方式从分散式向协调式转变，从而提升大城市老年护理服务系统的适应能力和治理效能。。研究方法：优化方法。

papers.title: Does the Belt and Road Initiative Reshape Imported Financial Risk? Evidence From China
papers.abstract: Against the backdrop of increasingly interconnected global financial markets and China's continued pursuit of high‐level opening‐up, effectively preventing imported financial risk while expanding openness has become an important issue in balancing development and security. Using data on Chinese listed firms from 2010 to 2024, this paper constructs firm‐level measures of imported financial risk based on extreme value theory and examines changes in firms' imported financial risk following the implementation of the BRI. Our findings show that following the implementation of the BRI, firms with pre‐existing exposure to BRI countries experience a significantly larger decline in imported financial risk relative to other firms. Channel analyses provide evidence consistent with exchange rate risk exposure, overseas geographical diversification, and operational resilience serving as potential channels associated with this decline in imported financial risk. Further analysis reveals a ‘double‐edged sword’ pattern across different sources of risk: firms with pre‐existing exposure to BRI countries exhibit lower imported financial risk from developed markets but stronger financial risk linkages with emerging markets in the post‐BRI period. This suggests that although market diversification is associated with lower dependence on risk from traditional developed markets, deeper integration into BRI emerging markets is associated with greater exposure to financial fluctuations in these markets. This paper provides firm‐level evidence on the relationship between opening‐up and financial security and offers important insights for policymakers and enterprises seeking to balance development and security in the process of opening‐up.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】在全球金融市场日益紧密相连的背景下，以及中国持续推动高水平对外开放的背景下，如何在扩大开放的同时有效防范外来金融风险，已成为平衡经济发展与金融安全的重要课题。本文利用2010至2024年间中国上市公司的数据，基于极值理论构建了企业层面的外来金融风险指标，并研究了“一带一路”倡议实施后企业外来金融风险的变化情况。研究结果表明，与其它企业相比，那些此前已与“一带一路”沿线国家有业务往来的企业在倡议实施后外来金融风险显著下降。渠道分析发现，汇率风险敞口、海外地理多元化以及运营韧性可能是导致外来金融风险下降的潜在因素。进一步分析还揭示了不同风险来源的“双刃剑”效应：在倡议实施前与“一带一路”沿线国家有业务往来的企业在来自发达市场的金融风险方面有所降低，但在倡议实施后与新兴市场的金融风险关联度却增强。这表明，虽然市场多元化有助于降低对传统发达市场风险的依赖，但更深入地融入“一带一路”新兴市场则可能增加对这些市场金融波动的敏感性。本文为企业层面提供了关于开放与金融安全之间关系的实证证据，为政策制定者和企业在开放进程中寻求平衡发展与安全提供了重要参考。。

papers.title: Recognizing Dominance through Local Improvement
papers.abstract: Strategy-proofness is the traditional standard for predictable behavior, yet participants often fail to play dominant strategies. Most existing simplicity concepts attribute these failures to the cost of contingent reasoning, which they lower by comparing the worst case of the dominant strategy with the best case of an alternative. I argue that there is another approach, one that makes more use of the structure of the strategy set, which I formalize as a neighbor relation. Comparing neighboring strategies can reduce the need for contingent reasoning, and, even with a single contingency, it can simplify the search through the strategy set. I introduce a new simplicity criterion: a mechanism is local improvement solvable under a neighbor relation if repeatedly moving to an improving neighbor always reaches a dominant strategy. Strategy-proofness is the criterion under the coarsest relation, and many classical mechanisms satisfy it under finer ones. In extensive-form mechanisms without duplicate dominant strategies, the criterion under one-situation neighbors is strict action-proofness, which is distinct from obvious strategy-proofness. Among local improvement solvable mechanisms that implement the same outcomes, the criterion predicts more dominant-strategy play where the local comparison is salient.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】“策略防伪性（Strategy-proofness）”是衡量行为可预测性的传统标准，然而参与者往往无法采取占优策略（dominant strategies）。现有的大多数简化理论（simplity concepts）将这些行为失灵归因于“条件性推理（contingent reasoning）”的成本，它们通过将占优策略的最坏情况与替代策略的最佳情况进行比较来降低这种成本。我认为还有另一种方法，这种方法能更充分地利用策略集合（strategy set）的结构，我将这种结构形式化为一种“邻接关系（neighbor relation）”。比较相邻策略可以减少条件性推理的需求；即使存在某种不确定性（contingency），这种方法也能简化对策略集合的搜索过程。我提出了一种新的简化标准：如果通过不断转向更优的策略（improving neighbor）总能找到占优策略，那么该机制就具备“局部可改进性（local improvement solvability）”。在最粗糙的邻接关系下，策略防伪性仍然是这一标准；许多经典机制在更精细的邻接关系下也满足这一标准。在不存在重复占优策略的扩展形式...。
